page.title: Look up commands and shared options
page.description: Browse every tinyactors command grouped by task and check the shared options accepted by all commands.

reference.headline: Look up commands and shared options
reference.p: Each tinyactors command performs one job on charts, compiled images, snapshots or a local JSON-RPC host. Every command accepts shared flags for Markdown, JSON (-f json) or XML output.

commands.title: tinyactors {command}
commands.program-options: Pass options shared across all commands
commands.shared: Configure output formats like -f json using the shared options on the command reference.

job.name: Compile, check, lint and format charts
job.summary: Build chart images, verify compilation, catch unreachable logic and format files into canonical layout.

job.commands: states transitions events data expressions path graph disassemble inspect
job.name: Inspect chart structure, paths and compiled images
job.summary: List states, transitions, events, data, expressions and bytecode, trace shortest paths, draw diagrams and inspect images.

job.name: Compare chart versions for breaking changes
job.summary: Show what changed between two chart versions and how those changes affect running actors.

job.name: Run a local host over JSON-RPC
job.summary: Start one host over JSON-RPC 2.0 on standard input and output for scripts and local testing.

job.name: Inspect snapshots and hibernation blobs offline
job.summary: List each snapshot actor's state, queued events and delayed sends, and inspect snapshot or blob contents.

job.name: Print command help and version information
job.summary: Display usage details for any command alongside the versions of tinyactors and its embedded library.
